name: ForgePad
description: The coin of ForgePad, the launchpad on Robinhood Chain. 1B fixed supply, no team allocation, no presale, no taxes, no owner. It opens on ForgePad's own bonding curve at a time fixed in the contract, for everyone at the same second, its creator included. At graduation the Uniswap v4 pool opens at the curve's last price, the position is locked for good, and every token the pool does not need is burned. FORGE receives 10% of every coin's trading fees and half of every launch fee: part of it buys FO
